reviewCharts.directionalScreenReason: Governor is the only same-grain comparison contest currently loaded for New Hampshire, and 2024 Governor ticket splitting is large enough to drive Harris/DEM directional labels without implying an election-administration anomaly.
corroborationNeeded: town/ward U.S. House or Executive Council comparison rows where district coverage is clean
historical New Hampshire President-versus-Governor split-ticket baselines

reviewCharts.warning: New Hampshire review rows are town/ward-level President-versus-Governor comparisons from archived official Secretary of State workbooks. Governor is used because New Hampshire did not have a 2024 U.S. Senate race. Directional labels from this comparison are low-confidence ticket-splitting proxies until corroborated by additional contests, historical baselines, or administration records. Town/ward boundary geometry is not included.
